title: GitHub remote, nested issues and Project v2 control plane
claim_boundary: The declarative control plane is source-verified; no remote repository, issue, subissue, Project or ruleset is claimed until an apply receipt exists. Path presence is not behavioural proof; assertion-level traceability governs implementation claims.

assertions.statement: Remote repository bootstrap and origin wiring
open_gates: Create or verify the public remote and push the committed main branch.
Supply an authenticated GitHub token with repository, Issues and Projects permission through protected environments.
Execute bootstrap and preserve observed repository, ruleset, issue, subissue and Project receipts.
assertions.permitted_claim: Source implementation is mapped, but compiler and runtime evidence remain separate.
